name: Little Tree | 200mg Live Resin Gummies | Blue Razz
description:
10 Gummies | 20MG Each | Live Resin

Bold. Consistent. Adventure-Ready.

Our Blue Razz Live Resin Gummies are crafted for full-spectrum flavor seekers. With 20MG of terpene-rich live resin per gummy, this edible offers a vivid burst of blue raspberry and a potent high that mirrors the complexity of the plant.

With smooth effects and a reliable chew, this gummy is a flavorful favorite for focused, balanced elevation.

Whether you're hitting the trails or diving into something creative—this gummy keeps the vibes flowing.
